name: 最近の保存先とフォルダーツリー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH15-0017, recent destination folders and folder tree, no full app.
Image1 ORIGINAL primary for folder glyph shapes, optical weight, proportions, tree indentation, selection/checkmark and fine control details. Use source x47 y991 w1084 h928 only. Preserve original Dropbox-folder identity artwork and camera-upload folder glyph with camera/UP arrow, correcting mock's crude generic solid green folders. Preserve recent selected row's circle/check, expanded root down-chevron, INDENTED camera child with right-chevron. Original recent camera row has no trailing arrow: do not copy the mock's invented recent-row chevron. Image2 OUR MOCK secondary for exact Japanese content and locked roles. Image3 approved white materials/brand selection only.
Exact labels and rows:
heading "最近のフォルダー"
selected recent row "すべてのファイル" / "ライトハウスの資料"
recent camera row "カメラから保存" / "すべてのファイル"
heading "すべてのフォルダー", action "新規フォルダー"
tree root "すべてのファイル" / "ライトハウスの資料"
indented tree child "カメラから保存" / "端末で追加した画像"
No extra rows or text. Meiryo Bold12/16px section headings, Regular14/24px folder labels, Regular12/16px metadata/action, tracking0. No giant heading or all-bold labels.
Logical width390px, compact rows, consistent baselines/16px inset. Selected first recent row white with fine forest-green outline and green filled-circle white check; unselected rows white. Tree child indent clearly under root. New-folder action far right on section header. One restrained rounded white group, fine neutral edge and subtle shadow, no nested cards.
Accent decision: Source blue selected check/action adapt forest-green#1F6444. Preserve original Dropbox logo artwork blue and camera-upload type identity colors as source artwork, consistent across repeated folders; ordinary chevrons slate#526173. Omit broad mint selection fill and decorative green generic folders from mock. No primary submit CTA inside region, do not add one.
Original controls disputed glyph/spacing/detail choices; mock secondary. Exclude source file preview/header/search/duplicate action, English, ID, watermark, metrics or annotations. Static design candidate.
reviewNotes: Original and mock opened, original Dropbox/camera-upload folder artwork, check circle and tree indentation prioritized over crude green vectors. Output inspected: four Japanese folder rows, current selection, root down-chevron and indented child retained; extra recent-camera arrow omitted. Source selection/action blue adaptedforestgreen, original type artwork blue preserved, utilities slate; white surface/no mint. Exact font/glyph metrics unproved; no owner/native/runtime acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
